messages:
Taylor: Quick design sync — compare table feels noisy. Badges are drawing attention away from the actual metric numbers.
Imani: Agreed. Users in the study kept scanning badges first and missing latency/accuracy values. Suggest we introduce a metric anchor column (pin a primary metric) so it never scrolls out.
Rex: Metric anchor sounds good. Could be per-user preference or per-session toggle. When anchor is set, the column becomes sticky and marked with a small anchor icon.
Sofia: Badge density idea: show only 10 visual badge (status dot + 3-char label) then collapse extras behind a "+n" chip that expands inline. Keeps rows tight.
Taylor: Accessibility: color-only dots are not enough. Each badge must expose an aria-label like "Throughput: 12k r/s, good" and expanded list must be keyboard-focusable.
Imani: Copy tweak: change "P95" to "Latency (p95)" in tooltips and sr-only labels. Also change "Pin" to "Pin model version" where it appears in menus.
Rex: Pin scope confusions again. Proposal: add a small scope toggle in the pin menu: [Global] [This search]. Default to "This search" to match user mental models from tests.
Sofia: Also show a subtle header scope chip when anything is pinned: "Pinned: v5.0.2 (global)" — clicking it opens pin settings. That helps when filters change.
Taylor: Motion note: animate pin->header with a short transform+opacity so users see the result. Keep it under 150ms and use transform/opacity only.
Imani: Keyboard order issue: current tab stops land inside badge popovers before actions. Fix order: row checkbox -> primary metric -> actions -> badges -> overflow.
Rex: Small CSS hint for compact badge hit area: visual 18x18, but .hit-area padding to reach 32px. Use outline on focus.
Sofia: QA: add tests for pin persistence across filter swaps, focus order on overflow expand, and aria-label outputs for badges.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: update PR template with a11y checklist: contrast ratios, aria labels, focus management, hit-target sizes.
Taylor: Next steps: Imani to prototype anchor + compact badges, Rex to mock pin-scope toggle, Sofia to draft QA tests, I'll collect a short usability follow-up.
Imani: On it, will push a Figma frame by EOD.
Rex: I'll add a tiny interaction spec for the scope toggle.
Sofia: I'll start the QA ticket and include steps for regression on pinned highlights.
Taylor: Thanks everyone.
